## Morning operator brief

A single actionable Discord card for the start of the day: fleet reachability, failed units, disk pressure, backups, certificate renewal, comin drift/reboots, the newest Hydra production evaluation, and aggregate 24-hour security activity.

The SOC endpoint accepts only the fixed window `24h`; Loom cannot submit PromQL or LogQL. Discord receives aggregate counts and names only—never raw logs, IP addresses, secrets, or alert bodies. Select the encrypted Discord webhook credential before publishing.
